Elena (CEO): opening the sec/privacy follow-up thread from the all-hands. short, focused q's please so we can capture action items. :sparkles:
Ravi (Solutions): clients asking: when will we publish SOC2 Type II evidence for evals / sales?
Arman (CISO): SOC2 Type II report will be available to customers under NDA after audit close—ETA early Q4. we'll publish a public readiness summary and control matrix next week.
Priya (Head of Product): will SOC2/ISO impose any new limits on hosted telemetry or product analytics?
Arman (CISO): no limits by default. we will document required controls and offer telemetry opt-outs for customers with stricter needs; defaults remain the same.
Jo (Eng Infra): VPC/private status: limited pilot for isolated control plane + audit log separation in late Q3; GA targeted Q4. pilot customers will get instructions for log ingest/export.
Ravi (Solutions): audit log retention question: can customers ask for configurable retention beyond 1 year?
Kofi (Legal): yes, long-term retention is an enterprise add-on; customers must sign the retention addendum. legal will coordinate DSR/responsibility clauses.
Arman (CISO): note: hosted default retention is 90 days for raw request logs, 365 days for aggregates. Dedicated/Private support customizable retention and S3 archival.
A user (via thread): BYOK for hosted — timeline?
Jo (Eng Infra): BYOK already supported for Dedicated/Private. hosted multi-tenant BYOK (customer-managed keys/wrapped) planned by end of year. HSM-backed offering for enterprise later.
Kofi (Legal): contractual point: BYOK/CMK customers require key-handling addenda and explicit language about emergency access and rotation policies.
Priya (Head of Product): will BYOK affect backups or restore SLAs?
Jo (Eng Infra): backups will be envelope-encrypted with customer DEKs; restore requires key access unless an escrow option is agreed. we'll include guidance in the enterprise runbook.
Ravi (Solutions): performance hit from KMS calls?
Arman (CISO): negligible on the hot path—envelope encryption is used and DEKs are cached. KMS ops happen mainly on key rotation or data-at-rest operations.
Elena (CEO): incident notification process - what's the customer-facing timeline?
Arman (CISO): severity-based. for major incidents: initial notification within 72 hours with a summary, dedicated bridge for impacted customers, and a full postmortem when ready. contractual SLA terms apply.
A user: will we expose a compliance dashboard for customers to see certs, logs, and artifacts?
Priya (Head of Product): yes — console will show compliance status, certs, and log export controls. initial version planned for Q4.
Jo (Eng Infra): sample audit export API (newline-delimited JSON):
```
GET /api/v1/audit/export?start=2025-07-01&end=2025-07-31&format=ndjson
```
Exports include timestamp, actor, route, resource_id, action, and a redaction flag.
Kofi (Legal): reminder: data subject request workflows and retention change impacts must go through Legal to align customer contracts.
Elena (CEO): action items: Arman/Kofi to post the readiness whitepaper + control matrix; Priya/Jo to publish pilot signup for VPC/BYOK. please DM with enterprise customers wanting early access. will close thread in 24h.
